content.comment_body: Hello, Whenever I open my [product_name] in network project mode, my [product_name] modules appear as "Unknown_1" and "Unknown_2". I rename them and save, but after restarting [product_name] their names revert to "Unknown". Thanks for your help. [user_name] I am using [product_name] [version_no] and [product_name] [version_no]

This is expected behavior. If you create a new network project and only connect to the [product_name] modules, [product_name] initially recognizes only the IP address. At this stage, [product_name] does not know the names of the modules and labels them "UnknownX". The names are only identified by [product_name] after downloading the programs from the modules.
Thank you for the clear explanation—it makes sense! Apologies for overlooking that. I'll give it a try.

analysis.insight_summary: Users notice that device naming within [product_name] is not saved after restarting; custom names revert to default placeholders like 'Unknown_1'. This happens because [product_name] only links device names with downloaded project data, not just IP connections in network mode, leading to recurring inconvenience for users who expect saved labels.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that any device names assigned in the network project should be retained across sessions in [product_name], even without downloading project data.
